Lad.name: Release_Brake
Lad.comment: Brake release latch. Requirement: * relbrk_btn is a momentary push button. Each press toggles an internal switch, so the operator can release and re-apply the brake by tapping. * While the line is running the switch is forced off: you may not leave the brake released during production. * The brake output energises when the switch is on OR while running. * The lamp follows the switch only, so the operator sees the manual state rather than the running state. Written from the requirement above using the instruction rules; the reference block does the edge toggle in SCL, this is the LAD equivalent.
